I am currently a **Research Professional at the [IMAGINA Research Center](https://imagina.uniandes.edu.co/), Universidad de los Andes**, where I build indicator systems, co-lead experimental research, and own analytical pipelines from raw data to estimation.

Most of my work sits between research and policy: turning administrative and survey microdata into evidence that government counterparts, civil society, and research teams can use and reproduce.

## Experience (Brief Overview)

- **Research Professional**\
  *IMAGINA Research Center, Universidad de los Andes \| Jun 2023 – Present*\
  Built and maintained the **SIYA indicator system** for the NiñezYA coalition and the **CUBOS RIPS** administrative health database (50M+ records). Co-led the design of a **pre-registered RCT** on violence detection and social norms. Estimated **SEM and mediation models** for working papers on childhood adversity.

- **Policy Data Analyst and Consultant**\
  *Secretaría de Integración Social, Bogotá District Government \| Jun 2025 – Feb 2026*\
  Led a team of 4–6 professionals evaluating **51 district social policies**. Applied **large language models** within an automated Python pipeline to extract, classify, and synthesize unstructured documents, and facilitated technical workshops with stakeholders across 20 localities.

- **Research Analyst**\
  *Vice-Presidency of Research & Creation, Universidad de los Andes \| Mar 2022 – May 2023*\
  Designed the **Theory of Change, KPIs, and cost-effectiveness analysis** for the Juanfe Foundation's 360 model, scoped the **Maternal and Child Health Dashboard** for Fundación Éxito, and harmonized **VACS microdata across 17 countries** (CDC- and USAID-sponsored).

- **Research Assistant Intern**\
  *Alberto Lleras Camargo School of Government, Universidad de los Andes \| Aug 2021 – Feb 2022*\
  Synthesized causal evidence and analyzed qualitative data on teenage pregnancy, child protection, and violence against children and women.

- **Teaching Assistant, Economic Analysis of Public Policy** (M.A. level)\
  *Alberto Lleras Camargo School of Government, Universidad de los Andes \| Aug 2024 – Present*
